$comment: ADR-493: dedicated fishing-rod art. The atlas has NO image file of its own: its pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/fishing-rod-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the task34 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas (items_build, the 64px creature atlas, like the bee) only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is one row of 8 frames of 48x48 (one per facing, dirStride 1, the held atlas cell size): frame f is the rod held at its butt, angling up-forward along the facing-f ground direction (TASK34_DIR_VEC). The sprite anchor is the hand (0.5, 0.75) and every frame carries the same grip anchor (-3, -5), like the axe, so the authored grip lands exactly on either hand.
